breakpoints.note: This is the first project statement on the crashing path that consumes attacker-controlled XML bytes into the vulnerable parser state consistent with the bug: a SAX1 start-tag parse whose result is later recorded with namePush rather than nameNsPush.

In the SAX1 branch, xmlParseElementStart records the open element only with namePush. That increments nameNr and stores the element name but leaves the parallel pushTab metadata array unallocated and uninitialized even though later code unconditionally reads pushTab[nameNr - 1].line.
